job.value: set up order and delivery promos for their buyers

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Discounts and promos' with 'Order promo' and 'Delivery promo' rows makes the page's purpose clear.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The two 'Edit' links and the upsell's 'Subscribe' link have the same teal weight, so nothing stands out as the way to create a promo.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Edit' next to 'No promos yet' doesn't predict creating a first promo; there is nothing to edit.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Order promo' vs 'Delivery promo' are not explained; a seller has to guess what each discounts.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: It only asks which kind of promo to set up.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Each promo type is a single summary row with details behind it.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: The 'Enjoy an ad-free experience and unlock saved search limits with Carousell Plus!' upsell is a buyer perk on a seller's promo page.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Short labels; the only sentence is the upsell.
